title: Finding Domain and Range from a Graph
body: Find the domain and range of the function, f, shown in the image.\n##figure1.gif

figureAlts.figure1.gif: A coordinate grid with the horizontal axis labeled x and the vertical axis labeled y. The x-axis has tick labels negative 5, negative 4, negative 3, negative 2, negative 1, 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5. The y-axis has tick labels 1, negative 1, negative 2, negative 3, negative 4, and negative 5. A blue curve labeled f starts at an open dot at negative 3, 0, falls to a low point at negative 2, negative 4, rises to a high point at 0, 0, then falls to a filled dot at 1, negative 4.
